s: Kamma dine haknasat shabbat ubo h' seipim: mitzva lirchotz kol gupo lekattechilla beereb shabbat bechammin, mippene kebod hashshabbat. Veim i epshar lo — yirchatz panayv yadayv veraglayv bechammin. Umikkol maqom, en rechitza zo choba gemura, ella hamqayyemah — meqabbel aleha sakar, vesheeno meqayyemah — eno neenash aleha. Umitzva lachop harosh ulegalleach hatztzippornayim bekol ereb shabbat. Veim hayu saarot rosho gedolot — mitzva legallechan, shello yikkanes leshabbat keshehu menuvval. Umitzva min hammubchar legalleach beereb shabbat mammash velo qodem laken, kede sheyyehe nikkar sheoseh likbod hashshabbat. Veim en lo penay beereb shabbat mechamat torach tzorke shabbat — yegallach beyom h', shekkol mah sheepshar leqareb haggilluach leyom hashshabbat — yesh lo leqareb, kede sheyyehe nikkar sheoseh bishbil kebodo. Venohagin biqtzat meqomot shello lehistapper berosh chodesh apillu chal beereb shabbat, mippene chashash sakkana, ki ken hizhir rabbenu yehuda hechasid:

Yesh nizharin shello liqtzotz tzipporne hayyadayim veharaglayim beyom echad, mippene chashash sakkana. Veyesh nizharin shello laqotz ella beereb shabbat o beereb yom tob, veqotzetzin min haraglayim beyom h' umin hayyadayim beereb shabbat, abal bishar hayyamim en qotzetzin kelal, mittaam hayyadua lahem. Veyesh maqpidim shello littol tzippornayim beyom h', mippene shehatztzippornayim matchilin lachazor velitzmoach beyom g' legilluchan, veenam rotzim sheyyihyeh zeh beshabbat:

Yesh maqpidim shello littol hatztzippornayim kesidran etzba achar etzba hassemuka lah, mippene sheqqasheh leshikcha veliqbor banim velaaniyyut, ella mapsiqim ben etzba leetzba beetzba acheret sheenah semuka lah. Umatchilin littol bismol biqmitza, dehaynu beetzba rebiit hassemuka lazzeret, ubeyamin beetzba, dehaynu etzba sheniyya hassemuka laggudal. Venimtza hassimman lesidran, bdag"h beyamin, ubismol dbhg"a. Veyesh maligim al zeh. Umikkol maqom, tob lizzaher lekatchilla:

Hassorep tzippornayim — chasid, qoberan — tzaddiq, zoreqan — rasha, shemma taabor alehen ishsha ubbara vetappil veladah. Abal muttar lezorqan bebet hammidrash vekayyotze bo maqom sheen nashim metzuyot laabor sham. Veen lachush shemma yekabbedu oto maqom veyashliku hatztzippornayim hachutza vetaabor ishsha ubbara alehen, lepi sheap im taabor alehen — lo yazziqu lah kelum, sheenan mazziqot ella keshehen beoto maqom shezzeraqan sham keshennittelu mehaetzbaot, abal lo kesheppinnan mishsham lemaqom acher:

Samuk lachasheka qodem ben hashshemashot — tzarik adam lishol leanshe beto im isseru happerot hatztzerikim leshabbat, sheen measserim beshabbat. Veap bimdinot ellu sheen hammaasrot nohagim — tob sheyyishal im hiprishu challa, sheen maprishin challa beshabbat. (Veap shechallat chutz laaretz okel veholek umeshayer meat veachar kak maprishah meiqqar haddin, mikkol maqom lekattechilla nohagim lehaprishah qodem akila, shemma yishkach achar kak venimtza sheakal tebel lemaprea). Vetzarik leshoolam gam ken im erebu erube chatzerot. Veakshav shennohagim leareb beereb pesach lekol hashshana — en tzarik lezeh. Vetzarik lehazhiram qodem ben hashshemashot sheyyadliqu et hanner, veyipsequ millaasot melaka. Ukeshehu shoalam umazhiram al debarim ellu — tzarik sheyyomar belashon rakka, kede sheyyeqabbelu mimmennu. Velo yemaher lehazkiram beod hayyom gadol, shello yipsheu veyomru adayin yesh shahut. Veim eno bebeto keshemmaggia samuk lachasheka ella bebet hakkeneset o bemaqom acher — tzarik lishloach shaliach lebeto lehazkiram al debarim ellu:
